# A08-S70: Bot access

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Hope all is well and that you write a lot :-)

As you may know, tomorrow is the big launch for MindFuture. I am to present the AI party [████] 😂 I don't know if you are coming, so I thought you should at least have the opportunity to see what I have managed to do with the things we talked about a few months ago.

The chatbots can be accessed by clicking ‘Discussion’ on this website, and then writing in the general meeting thread according to the manual in the description: www.detsyntetiskeparti.org . One AI is online 24/7, but if you want to try both, just write to me about the time - because it must not run all the time for OpenAI, which has not approved my project because they do not want to distinguish between art and politics (a lovely reversed gift).

There is also a bunch of other stuff and links on the website to various other blogs and videos.

And tomorrow I have to speak over this extremely noisy machine: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fRTDtfYGn5w

There needs to be grit in the IT industry!

See you sometime,

All the best, [████]
